stem: A group of friends shares the cost of a dinner equally, and each person pays \$36. If 3 more friends had joined and the same total cost had been shared equally, each person would have paid \$27. What is the total cost, in dollars, of the dinner?
solution: Let \(n\) be the number of friends. The total cost is \(36n\), and also \(27(n + 3)\).
verify:
n = symbols('n')
ns = solve(Eq(36*n, 27*(n + 3)), n)
assert ns == [9]
s = 36*ns[0]
assert s == 324
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == s and len(spr_answers) == 1
